Name: Skip Fishing Minigame
Author: dewmods
Description:
[b][u]ACKNOWLEDGEMENT[/u][/b]
Thank you to all the generous people who have supported this mod through donations and kind words, it's very much appreciated! I am humbled by the popularity of this mod. I hope you all continue to enjoy this fantastic game!

[u][b]DETAILS[/b][/u]
This mod removes the fishing minigame after you hook a fish. As long as you pull your line when the fish bites, you will catch the fish!
Optionally, you can now enable auto-fish so when a fish bites, they will be hooked without any input required (see CONFIG section - Generic Mod Config Menu is supported!).
[u][b]
[u][b]REQUIREMENTS[/b][/u]
[/b][/u]Stardew Valley 1.6.3
SMAPI 4.0.6[u][b]

[u][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/u]
[/b][/u][list=1]
[*]Download latest mod file
e.g. "[i]SkipFishingMinigame 0.5.1.zip[/i]"

[*]Extract the contents of the mod file to your Stardew Valley mods folder
e.g. "[i]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\"[/i]
[i]
[/i][*]Launch Stardew Valley using SMAPI
[/list][u][b][u][b]
CONFIG
[/b][/u][/b][/u]Generic Mod Config Menu now supported!

The follow config values are available:

[i]IsActionButtonToggleAutoHook[/i]
- Default value: false
- Set to true to use the Action button to toggle AutoHook enchantment on the fishing rod you've selected on your toolbar.

[i]IsAutoHook[/i]
- Default value: false
- Set to true to apply AutoHook enchantment whenever you fish.
- Does not work if IsRemoveAutoHook is also set to true!

[i]IsRemoveAutoHook[/i]
- Default value: false
- Set to true to remove AutoHook enchantment whenever you fish.
- This will override IsAutoHook behaviour!

[i]PerfectCatchChance[/i]
- Default value: 100
- Set to 75 for a 75% chance of getting a perfect catch.

[i]IsIgnoreTreasureChests
[/i]- Default value: false
- Set to true to ignore treasure chests while fishing.

[i]MinimumCatchesRequired[/i]
- Default value: 0
- Set to 3 to require successfully catching a fish type 3 times before the mod will start skipping the fishing minigame for that fish type.[u][b]

INSTRUCTIONS
[/b][/u][list=1]
[*]Just fish like you normally would!
[*]To toggle "Auto-Hook" on your rod
a) Enable "IsActionButtonToggleAutoHook" in the config.
b) Hold / select your fishing rod on your toolbar
c) Right-click (on PC) or press the "Action" button to toggle Auto-Hook enchantment on/off - a sound cue will play

[/list]
[b][u]FAQ
[/u][/b][b]1. Can I still catch legendary fish?
[/b]Yes!

[b]2. Can I still get treasure?[/b]
Yes!

[b]3. Are quality and size of fish affected?[/b]
Not at all, the vanilla Stardew Valley calculations remain unaffected.

[b]4. What about "perfect" catches?[/b]
All catches are "perfect" by default. The % chance of a perfect catch can now be configured (see CONFIG section).

[b]4.1[/b][b]. Why are my catches no longer "purple" rating?
[/b]Several factors can affect this, the main ones are:
- Fish quality (location)
- Daily luck
- Perfect catch (a perfect catch raises the fish rating by 1, e.g. gold -> purple)
- Casting strength

[b]5. Will my Collection still update the number of fish caught?
[/b]Yes!

[b]6. Do I still get fishing experience?[/b]
Yes!

[b]7. Can you catch double-fish?
[/b]Yes!
Received reports that double-fish can occur (thanks to user "skleetons").

[b]8. Why has it taken so long for you to update the mod?
[/b]Been busy with our 2 young children.

[b]9. Where is the config.json file?
[/b]YOU MUST launch the game at least once after installing the mod.

To edit the config, open the config.json file using any text editor (e.g. notepad).
e.g. "[i]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\SkipFishingMinigameDotnet5[/i][i]\config.json"[/i][u][b]
[/b][/u][u][b]
[/b][/u][b][b]10.[/b][/b][b] Does this work on Ginger Island / Festivals?[/b][u][b]
[/b][/u]Yes!

[b][b]11.[/b][/b][b] Does this work on multiplayer[/b][u][b]?
[/b][/u]I've yet to thoroughly test local / online multiplayer. Please let us know your experience! [UPDATED: See below post]
[quote][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/25329374]Kindleshard[/url]
[url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?showtopic=6919581/#entry110308893]09 June 2022, 9:21PM[/url]
I have tested the mod on multiplayer for an in-game year. No issue, works fine [/quote]
[b]12. The mod doesn't work!
[/b]Highly appreciate the community contribution on the following info:
- Teh's Fishing Mod has been reported to be incompatible with this mod unfortunately.
- I only test on the latest Steam version.

[b]13. There is no "config.json" file!
[/b]If the "config.json" file is not being created for some reason:

You can download the default one in the optional files section.

[b]14. This mod breaks when there is a treasure chest![/b]
Fixed in the latest version of this mod (v0.5.1)

[b]15. I'm not getting any treasure chests![/b]
There was a previous config.json which had treasure chests disabled. Please check the value for:
[code]"IsIgnoreTreasureChests": false,[/code]and make sure it is set to [b]false[/b] to find treasure chests again.

[b]16. How do I edit the config?
[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=description]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is now supported![b]
[/b]Alternatively, follow the "Configure mods" section on: [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started[/url]
